body:
Ok so I don't mind admitting: I am a severe addict to anything euphoric and anything to escape, but it seems I picked the wrong drug the first couple hits of crack are incredible, but too much of a good thing can go bad as happened to myself very bad after I was out of crack out of money I began to have the worst panic I've ever experienced.  My muscles clenched up I thought death was near but luckily I still got a couple good friends who will indeed help if I need it.  So I called my boy, told my situation and he drove over with five blue footballs I ate them immediately and after a half hour my stomach began to untie and feel warm so I know I'm on the path to relief and so I was not too much memory after that but basically I wrote this to discourage people from using that devil crack it will suck you dry straight up.
